name: Mosaic no Tenshi
storyline:
A man who has lost all dreams and hopes, living days of mere existence—
the leader of an amateur AV filming circle, Hiraki Shuu.

A female college student addicted to hosts and buried in debt as an OL,
or perhaps a single mother struggling through life, or a sex industry worker…
He had grown weary of dealing only with such women every day.
Then, he meets one female student: Ibuki Hina

The mysterious runaway girl wrapped in the cool summer breeze says: "Turn me into money."

The secrets hidden within her. The wishes she keeps concealed.
Through this encounter, even Shuu's own previously flavorless and monotonous life begins to change—

Her dreams,
hopes and salvation
wrapped in fiction.
